UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information on the ColorCanvas platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: The unique username chosen by the user.

email.description: The user's email address. Used for display; authentication is handled by an external system.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile image stored in Firebase Storage.

bio.description: A short biographical description provided by the user.

generationCount.description: The total number of AI images generated by the user. Capped at 5.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

Artwork.title: Artwork
Artwork.description: Represents an uploaded piece of artwork or content shared by a user on ColorCanvas.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Artwork entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who uploaded this artwork.

description.description: A detailed description of the artwork.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the artwork was uploaded.

likesCount.description: The total number of likes received by this artwork.

tags.description: An array of tags associated with the artwork.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment made by a user on an artwork.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Comment entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who made this comment.

artworkId.description: Reference to the Artwork on which this comment was made.

text.description: The actual text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the comment was posted.

/posts/{postId}/likes/{likerId}.description: Markers for user likes on posts.
